rewrites.yea_description: Voted to override the Governor's veto of Senate Bill 631, which adds shooting into a building to the crimes requiring 85 percent of the sentence. The Oklahoma House voted 68-17 to override the veto. The Senate had already done the same, so the bill became law.
rewrites.nay_description: Voted against overriding the Governor's veto of Senate Bill 631, which adds shooting into a building to the crimes requiring 85 percent of the sentence. The Oklahoma House voted 68-17 to override the veto. The Senate had already done the same, so the bill became law.

rewrites.yea_description: Voted for House Bill 2764, which cuts the top income tax rate from 4.75 to 4.5 percent from 2026, with a path for more cuts. The Oklahoma House passed it 74-19. The Governor signed it.
rewrites.nay_description: Voted against House Bill 2764, which cuts the top income tax rate from 4.75 to 4.5 percent from 2026, with a path for more cuts. The Oklahoma House passed it 74-19. The Governor signed it.
